compile_cpp_examples: compile C++ code examples from documentation literal blocks using the CPlusPlusTranslator compile method
run_cpp_examples: run compiled C++ examples and capture their output using the run_ method with stdin support
build_with_bjam: build C++ examples using bjam through the build method with configurable target rules and requirements
test_examples_with_jamfile: test C++ examples by writing them to a dump directory and generating Jamfile.v2 for later compilation
run_python_interactive: run Python interactive session examples from documentation by stripping prompt markers and executing the code
